# SEEN-089 declares a dependency that is not delivered

The ticket's frontmatter says `depends_on: [SEEN-006, SEEN-086]`. SEEN-086 is done; SEEN-006, which
scaffolds the pnpm turborepo monorepo, is not. There is no `package.json`, no `pnpm-workspace.yaml`
and no `packages/` in the tree.

Three of the five acceptance criteria need it:

- AC2 wants a non-negative coverage delta on `packages/core`, which does not exist.
- AC3 wants CI to run typecheck, migrations twice, tests with coverage, build and
  `pnpm audit --audit-level high`. None of those have anything to run against, and migrations need
  SEEN-007 and SEEN-008 as well.
- The carried-in work from SEEN-087 and SEEN-088 (refuse a delivery whose checks are not green,
  compare the receipt's commit to the branch tip) needs none of it.

What can be built today, against the harness itself: the RED-must-actually-fail rule, per-slice
evidence enforcement, the CI-green condition on `verify-delivery`, the receipt-versus-tip check at
merge, the pull request template, and rework counting. That is most of the ticket's value and all of
its carried-in work.

This is a judgement for the founder, recorded here before the clarify record is written.
